scene_description: A young girl in a striped shirt and pink shorts stands at a wooden fence railing near water, feeding elephants with her hand. She holds a basket and is reaching toward the trunk of one of two large elephants.

questions.question: Who is feeding the elephants?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the person standing at the fence.

questions.question: What animals are in the picture?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the big animals near the water.

questions.question: What is the girl carrying?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at what the girl is holding near her side.

questions.question: Where is the girl standing?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the wooden rails near the girl's feet.

questions.question: What is the elephant using to reach the girl?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the long part of the elephant stretching toward the girl's hand.
